# P4 Code Review

**Main thread: technique `background_review` below is everything you need. Read references/full-review.md only to run `--inline` or as the `--runner`.**

Review a Perforce changelist with a multi-agent code review that runs in the BACKGROUND by default, so the agent keeps working (technique `background_review`): a pending CL in this workspace is reviewed on its frozen shelf (or, when the shelf is not the review's own and differs, on a frozen copy of the workspace files), a submitted CL or another client's CL as it stands, and a runner returns the verdict. A review Claude invokes asks no pre-launch question. `--inline` runs `full_review` (references/full-review.md) in the foreground instead. The diff is partitioned on disk into chunks (under a 1 MB cap); reviewer subagents (set by the selected review profile) run **once per (role x chunk)**, and an independent validator confirms each flagged issue. Path-scoped pre-submit reminders (submit gates) authored in ancestor CLAUDE.md files are surfaced alongside the review for author confirmation. The diff chunks, bundle.json, and pre-images in bundle.bundle_dir are transient scratch under the plugin data root; declined findings persist in a durable ledger (references/declined-ledger.md).

```yaml
technique_skill:
  _schema_version: "1"
  trigger_model: auto
  identity: Run a multi-agent code review of a Perforce changelist using parallel Claude subagents.
  scope:
    covers:
      - reviewing a pending CL in the background on its frozen shelf, or a submitted or other-client CL as it stands, while the agent keeps working
      - reviewing pending Perforce changelists by CL number
      - CLAUDE.md compliance audits in a P4 workspace
      - bug audits scoped to introduced code
      - surfacing path-scoped pre-submit reminders (submit gates) from CLAUDE.md
    excludes:
      - git diffs and non-Perforce review workflows
      - publishing the rendered review to Swarm or a PR comment
      - enforcing submit gates (advisory only; enforcement belongs in a pre-shelve/pre-submit hook)
  techniques:
    - id: background_review
      name: Background review on a frozen snapshot (default)
      keywords: [background review, snapshot, freeze, shelf, workspace, runner, non-blocking review]
      goal: Review one pending CL while the agent keeps working, and tell the user whether the CL still equals what was reviewed.
      preconditions:
        - "Who invoked this skill decides what you may ask. USER-invoked: the turn carries a `<command-name>` tag naming this skill, because the user typed `/p4-code-review`. CLAUDE-invoked: every other start -- you called the Skill tool, or you are the `--runner` agent. When unsure, treat the review as Claude-invoked. A Claude-invoked review asks no pre-launch question: it picks the CL (step 1) and settles the shelf (step 2) itself. A user-invoked review asks only the two questions those steps name, and only when the answer was not already given."
        - The CL is pending with its files open in THIS workspace (freeze it, steps 2-3), or it is submitted or belongs to another client: that CL has no workspace files to protect, so skip step 2 and launch the runner with `<CL> --runner` and no `--snapshot` (prepare reads `p4 describe`; there is no frozen view, `--claim` is refused, files are read from the workspace).
        - "`--inline` runs `full_review` in the foreground and skips this technique. `<CL> --runner [--snapshot <record>]` marks the background agent itself: it runs `full_review` in runner mode and never this technique. Both read the procedure from references/full-review.md."
      steps:
        - n: 1
          action: |
            Resolve the CL number. A CL given in the arguments is used as given. Without one, a
            Claude-invoked review picks the CL itself and asks nothing: the pending CL that holds the files
            this session changed (`p4 opened <file>` names a file's CL), else the newest of
            `p4 changes --me -s pending -m 20`. A user-invoked review asks which CL, once, listing that output.
        - n: 2
          action: |
            Freeze a pending CL, a few seconds and the only synchronous work: run "${BOOTSTRAP_PYTHON:?requires bootstrap >= 0.120.0}" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/snapshot_review.py" freeze <CL>
            and add `--foreign-shelf workspace` when the review is Claude-invoked. It prints JSON `{cl, snapshot,
            record, bundle_dir, source, auto_shelved, reshelved, files}`. Exit 1: report its stderr.
            The CL's shelf is the user's unless this review created it. No shelf: freeze makes one
            (`auto_shelved`). A shelf equal to the open files: pinned as it stands. A shelf this review
            created that went stale (an earlier run was cut off): replaced from the open files with no
            question (`reshelved`); freeze again only after the earlier runner for that CL has handed
            back, because a runner still reading the older shelf then fails loudly. A shelf the review did
            NOT create that differs from the workspace is never touched. With `--foreign-shelf workspace`
            freeze copies the CL's open workspace files into the snapshot and reports `source: workspace`;
            the review reads those copies, so editing meanwhile stays safe. Without the flag a
            user-invoked freeze exits 3 naming the files: ask the user once how to proceed -- review the
            workspace files (run it again with `--foreign-shelf workspace`), replace the shelf (they run or
            approve `p4 shelve -f -c <CL>`, then you freeze again), or review the shelf as it stands
            (`--use-shelf`). After freeze returns, edits to the workspace cannot reach the review's diff.
          tool: Bash
        - n: 3
          action: |
            Launch ONE background Agent with `subagent_type: general-purpose`, `run_in_background: true`
            and no `model` override, using this fixed runner brief (fill in the CL and record, add nothing else):
              Invoke p4-kit:p4-code-review with `<CL> --runner --snapshot <record>` (no `--snapshot` for a
              submitted or other-client CL), then read the skill's references/full-review.md and follow
              `full_review` in runner mode. Run it against `prepare_review.py <CL> [--snapshot <record>]`.
              Never ask the user, edit, reconcile, reopen,
              shelve or submit. Return the rendered review, bundle.snapshot.record, bundle.change_id,
              bundle.ledger_baseline, bundle.bundle_dir, every NEEDS-THE-USER gate as a `?` item with its
              question, the fold-in candidates, and every lane failure. Finish with step 10's cleanup and,
              when frozen, `snapshot_review.py drop <record> --tree-only`.
            Then tell the user in one line that the review of CL <CL> is running on snapshot <snapshot>,
            and RETURN TO WORK. Do not wait, poll, sleep or check on the runner: its verdict arrives as a
            task notification. The diff and the CL's generic files are read from the frozen shelf (from the
            frozen workspace copies when `source` is `workspace`);
            claimed Markdown and files outside the CL are read from the workspace, so an edit to one of
            those while the runner works makes that part of the review stale (step 4 names it).
          tool: Agent
        - n: 4
          action: |
            On hand-back, run "${BOOTSTRAP_PYTHON:?requires bootstrap >= 0.120.0}" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/snapshot_review.py" verify <record> (a frozen CL only;
            exit 1 lists every CL file that changed since the freeze). Then present the findings, every
            `?` gate, the fold-in candidates and the changed files in ONE turn (one AskUserQuestion). Run the
            decision pass over the code-review and md-domain findings, record declined findings
            (references/declined-ledger.md, Record, using the runner's bundle_dir), and apply accepted
            fixes and fold-ins (`p4 reconcile -c` / `p4 reopen -c`). If the runner could not launch (no
            Claude pool), run `full_review` inline (references/full-review.md) instead.
        - n: 5
          action: |
            Fixes, fold-ins, or files `verify` reported as changed: freeze again and launch a new runner.
            p4 has no delta review -- the new snapshot replaces the reviewed one, so the whole CL is
            reviewed again. Then run "${BOOTSTRAP_PYTHON:?requires bootstrap >= 0.120.0}" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/snapshot_review.py" drop <superseded record>.
        - n: 6
          action: |
            Before the CL is submitted, run `verify <latest record>` and report the result with the
            snapshot id: exit 0 means the CL equals the reviewed snapshot and is ready for the user's own
            `p4 submit -c <CL>`; exit 1 names the files to review again first. This skill never submits.
            If the user asks to submit while the runner is still working, say the review is running.
          tool: Bash
      checklist:
        - Invoker identified from the `<command-name>` tag; a Claude-invoked review asked no pre-launch question
        - CL frozen before editing resumed; a shelf the review did not create never touched (the workspace files frozen instead, or the user's choice)
        - ONE runner launched with `run_in_background: true` and the fixed brief; the user told in one line; no waiting, polling or sleeping
        - verify run on hand-back; findings, every `?` gate, fold-in candidates and changed files presented in one turn
        - Fixes and fold-ins reviewed again on a new freeze; superseded records dropped
        - verify reported with the snapshot id before the CL is submitted; nothing submitted by the agent
```
